title: Artificial Intelligence
summary: Explore AI from its first ideas to modern LLMs and agents: code search, logic, Bayes, a perceptron, softmax and convolutions yourself, then learn prompting, safety and how to build with AI APIs.

title: Authentication & Security
summary: Learn how logins really work and how to protect them: password hashing, sessions, JWT, OAuth and OpenID Connect, MFA, passkeys, permissions and defenses against common attacks.

title: Business Intelligence
summary: Learn how companies turn raw data into trusted dashboards: KPIs, ETL/ELT, star schemas, OLAP, SQL, BI tools and governance, with hands-on Python and SQLite exercises.

title: C Programming
summary: Learn C from your very first printf to pointers, dynamic memory, structs, files and safe professional code. Understand how computers really work.

title: Cloud Computing
summary: Understand the cloud from the ground up: service models, regions, compute, storage, databases, networking, IAM, scaling, cost, the big providers and infrastructure as code.

title: C++ Programming
summary: Go from your first std::cout to the STL, classes, templates, smart pointers and modern C++ problem solving. Build fast, safe, professional programs.

title: Data Analytics
summary: Go from a business question to a clear, honest answer: collect and clean data, compute statistics, group, visualize, test hypotheses and tell a story, with hands-on Python exercises.

title: Database Management
summary: Learn databases from the very first table to professional practice: SQL queries, joins, design, indexes, transactions, backups, security and NoSQL, with real SQL exercises run through Python's sqlite3.

title: Deployment & DevOps
summary: Take your code from your laptop to real users: builds, environments, secrets, Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, safe releases, rollbacks, monitoring and Kubernetes.

title: Domains & DNS
summary: Understand how names on the internet work: buy a domain, master DNS records and TTLs, connect it to hosting, add free HTTPS, and set up email records that keep you out of spam.

title: Data Structures & Algorithms
summary: Think like a problem solver: Big-O, arrays, hashing, stacks, queues, linked lists, recursion, sorting, binary search, trees, heaps, graphs, Dijkstra, DP and greedy, with a judged contest-style problem in every lesson.

title: Web Hosting
summary: Learn where websites and apps actually live: shared, VPS, dedicated, cloud and serverless hosting, free static hosts, backends, databases, CDNs, backups and how to pick a host without surprise bills.

title: HTML & CSS
summary: Build real web pages from scratch: structure content with semantic HTML, then style and lay it out with modern CSS, flexbox, grid and responsive, accessible design.

title: Java
summary: Learn Java from your first public class Main to interfaces, generics, collections and streams. Every lesson has a narrated video, notes, a quiz and a judged coding exercise.

title: JavaScript
summary: Learn the language of the web from your first console.log to classes, error handling, promises and modules, with a judged exercise in every lesson.

title: Machine Learning
summary: Learn how machines learn from data: build regression, k-NN, trees, k-means and a tiny neural network from scratch in Python, then master evaluation and the professional ML workflow.

title: Data Communication & Networking
summary: From bits on a wire to secure web traffic: signals, media, OSI and TCP/IP, Ethernet, IP and subnetting, routing, TCP/UDP, DNS, HTTP, Wi-Fi and security, with Python calculators you build yourself.

title: Operating Systems
summary: Discover what really happens inside your computer: the kernel, processes and threads, CPU scheduling, virtual memory, file systems, devices, concurrency and security, with hands-on C simulations of real OS algorithms.

title: Python
summary: Learn Python from your very first print() to classes, generators, type hints and dataclasses. Every lesson has a narrated video, notes, a quiz and a judged coding exercise.

title: Servers & Backend
summary: Learn how the backend of every app works: HTTP, building servers and REST APIs in Node.js, databases, logging, scaling, Linux and security.

title: Software Development
summary: Learn how professional software is really made: requirements, design, clean code, Git, testing, debugging, agile teamwork, CI/CD and growing your career, with hands-on Python exercises.

title: TypeScript
summary: Add a powerful type system to JavaScript: annotations, interfaces, unions, narrowing, generics, classes and utility types, with a judged exercise in every lesson.

title: Web Development
summary: Go from "how does a web page even load?" to planning, building, securing and publishing a real full-stack site, with runnable HTML pages in every lesson.
